notes: do at all go back: at all is the infinitive absolute's fixed adverbial under rule 56, headed on all, while the auxiliary do and the particle back belong to the finite verb.
The even before these that remain is added: no object marker stands on the phrase it introduces (rule 16).
יתר הגוים האלה: the demonstrative takes the written these under rule 41, the article on the rectum is unrepresented, and the construct takes the supplied the under rule 29's count.
